commands.assertions: Five focused tests pass: browser speech fallback when Audio Tools is unavailable, configured server TTS, abort on stop, and existing STT unavailable/transcript behavior.
Twelve chat workspace and speech tests pass with speech controls mounted only for assistant messages and message text unchanged by cancellation.
Portal string generation and TypeScript checks pass for the optional speech integration.

assertions: Voice capture remains optional: when Audio Tools is absent, the voice control reports unavailable while text composition remains usable.
Configured Audio Tools TTS is selected for assistant messages and receives an AbortSignal.
Browser speechSynthesis is the bounded fallback when the optional TTS provider is missing or unhealthy.
Stop cancels pending synthesis and playback without changing the assistant message content.
Speech controls are rendered for assistant messages in the shared chat workspace and remain localized in English, Japanese, and Arabic.
limitations: No live Audio Tools provider was available on this host, so provider health and actual STT/TTS audio bytes are covered by deterministic client seams and UI tests rather than a live speech journey.
